articles.제목: Copenhagen Atomics to build deconversion facility
articles.원문 요약: Danish molten salt reactor developer Copenhagen Atomics has signed a memorandum of understanding with uranium enrichment services provider Urenco to construct a uranium deconversion facility in Copenhagen.

articles.제목: Belgian nuclear power plant negotiations extended
articles.원문 요약: The Belgian state, Engie and Electrabel have agreed to postpone to 12 December the target date for the conclusion of the heads of terms for the potential acquisition of Belgium's seven nuclear power reactors by the state.

articles.제목: Helen to assess environmental impacts of SMR in Helsinki
articles.원문 요약: Finland's Helen Ydinvoima Oy has launched an environmental impact assessment on the construction of a small nuclear power plant at one of three potential sites in Helsinki.

articles.제목: Algae early-warning system aims to offer safety, operational benefits
articles.원문 요약: An AI-based system has been developed to anticipate the arrival of floating vegetation masses at the cooling system of the Ascó Nuclear Power Plant in Spain, and is a significant advance on traditional visual inspection methods, say its creators, GDES and plant operator ANAV.
